title: Sindh Government Servants Benevolent Fund Amendment Act 2012

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Government Servants Benevolent Fund Amendment Act 2012
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XII OF 2012
ACT XII OF 2012
SINDH GOVERNMENT SERVANTS BENEVOLENT FUND (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2012
An Act to amend the Sindh
Government Servants Benevolent Fund Ordinance, 1960.
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV,
12th June, 2012]
NO.PAS/Legis-B-11/2012,
dated 11-6-2012.---The Sindh Government Servants
Benevolent Fund (Amendment) Bill, 2012 having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of Sindh on 27th April, 2012 and assented to
by the Governor of Sindh on 5th June, 2012 is hereby
published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---Whereas it
is expedient to amend the Sindh .Government Servants
Benevolent Fund Ordinance, 1960, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as
follows:-
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Sindh Government
Servants Benevolent Fund (Amendment) Act, 2012.
(2) It shall come into force
at once.
